_about: Quantitative accuracy proof for the Valuein SEC fact dataset, regenerated nightly from production by .github/workflows/publish-accuracy-baseline.yml.  Re-derive locally: scripts/accuracy/accuracy_check.sql.

standardized_facts._definition: A filing is 'clean' when it passes every active error-severity accounting identity in identities.json.

legacy_pre_2010._note: Pre-2010 XBRL was optional; most pre-2010 filings have no facts and trivially pass every identity. Use modern_2010_onward as the honest measurement.

unstandardized_facts._definition: A fact with standard_concept='Other' is correctly unstandardized if it is non-us-gaap namespace or a long-tail us-gaap tag with < 5 000 facts in our corpus.

reproducibility.run_command: duckdb -c 'LOAD httpfs; CREATE SECRET (TYPE HTTP, EXTRA_HTTP_HEADERS MAP {"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"}); .read scripts/accuracy/accuracy_check.sql'

sources: Penman (2013) — Financial Statement Analysis and Security Valuation 5e
